We can only use parallel RCT data of heme vs non-heme (unblinded)

Follow-up study (2016): effect of iron treatment on hepcidin (primary outcome); interaction between hepcidin levels at baseline and effects of iron on ferritin and Hb; correlation between hepcidin and ferritin/Hb at baseline and post-treatment; hepcidin concentrations between responders and non-responders for ferritin and Hb in donors under iron supplementation
Char: Notes: This study performed intention-to-treat analysis
